title: The canonical source-only localized comparison
statement: For a cartesian square g':X'→X, f':X'→S', f:X→S, g:S'→S [def-pc-base-change], a complex P, a derived isomorphism e:QP≅K and an invertible pullback counit [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], define r at p and degree i as localizedComparison of the stalk complex, followed by homology of tensorStalkIso, the inverse exact representative/stalk isomorphism, and the stalk of cohomology of counit inverse followed by Lg'(e). Its target is the stalk H^i(Lg'^*K); no additional target morphism is applied. This relocates the existing construction without changing it.

lean.statement: def affineBaseChangeIntoPullback {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K) (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))) (p : X') (i : ℤ) : letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' p letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq p letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq p).toAlgebra letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p)) letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p)) (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p ⊗[SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p] SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p) (SingleComplexBaseChange.C p))).obj ((SingleComplexBaseChange.cohomologyModel f f' g g' sq p P).cohomology i) ⟶ (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X'.toRingedSpace p).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) i).obj ((derivedPullback g').obj K))
